script.es: Tu auto, cuidado como se merece.
script.en: Your car, cared for the way it deserves.

parrafo.es: En 1447 S Adams St lavamos, encerramos y pulimos autos a mano desde hace más de una década. Rines, faros y pintura, todo revisado con calma antes de devolverte las llaves.
parrafo.en: At 1447 S Adams St we have been hand washing, waxing and polishing cars for over a decade. Wheels, headlights and paint, all checked carefully before we hand back your keys.

hero.imagen_alt: Exquisite's Car Detailing team member hand-polishing a car hood with an orbital buffer

parrafo_1.es: Exquisite's Car Detailing es un negocio de Tallahassee dirigido por Earl Callahan, conocido por sus clientes como Mr. Callahan. Un cliente que lleva más de diez años trayendo sus autos lo resume así: 'Es simplemente donde vamos'.
parrafo_1.en: Exquisite's Car Detailing is a Tallahassee shop run by Earl Callahan, known to his customers as Mr. Callahan. One customer who has been bringing his cars in for over ten years put it simply: 'It's just where we go.'

parrafo_2.es: Trabajamos bajo el mismo techo en 1447 S Adams St: lavado a mano, encerado, limpieza de rines y llantas, corrección de pintura y restauración de faros, con el cuidado de un taller que conoce cada auto que entra.
parrafo_2.en: We work under the same roof at 1447 S Adams St: hand washing, waxing, tire and rim cleaning, paint correction and headlight restoration, with the care of a shop that knows every car that pulls in.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué necesita tu auto. Sin formularios ni apps: solo una llamada al (448) 666-3346.
texto.en: Tell us what your car needs. No forms, no apps: just a call to (448) 666-3346.

titulo.en: We quote it on the spot

texto.es: Cada auto es distinto, así que cotizamos según el tamaño y el estado antes de tocar una esponja.
texto.en: Every car is different, so we quote based on size and condition before a sponge touches it.

texto.es: Lavado a mano, encerado, rines y llantas, o corrección de pintura: lo que tu auto necesite, bajo el mismo techo.
texto.en: Hand wash, wax, wheels and tires, or paint correction: whatever your car needs, all under one roof.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado contigo antes de entregarte las llaves. Así ha sido por más de diez años.
texto.en: We go over the result with you before handing back the keys. That is how it has been for over ten years.

nota.es: Cada operación se cotiza según tu vehículo. Llámanos al (448) 666-3346 y te damos el precio antes de empezar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on your vehicle. Call us at (448) 666-3346 and we will give you the price before we start.

texto.es: Lavado completo a mano y encerado que deja el auto protegido y con brillo, sin pasar por un túnel automático.
texto.en: A full hand wash and wax that leaves your car protected and shining, no automatic tunnel involved.

texto.es: Rines y llantas limpiados a fondo, quitando el freno acumulado y devolviéndole el brillo al metal.
texto.en: Wheels and tires cleaned thoroughly, brake dust and grime lifted so the metal shines again.

texto.es: Rayones y marcas leves pulidos a mano hasta devolverle profundidad al color original.
texto.en: Light scratches and swirl marks polished out by hand until the paint's original depth comes back.

texto.es: Faros opacos o amarillentos pulidos hasta quedar transparentes otra vez, para ver y que te vean mejor.
texto.en: Cloudy or yellowed headlights polished back to clear, so you see better and get seen better.

pie.es: ¿Necesitas algo que no ves aquí? Llámanos, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Need something you don't see here? Call us, we probably cover it.

items.quote: Service was incredible, and the quality of wash exceeded my expectations. They finished the exterior detailing quickly without sparing attention to detail.
Exquisite's Car Detailing did an excellent job. They made a 12 year old car look new. They steamed the carpet in the car and the trunk, removing grime and dirt.
We've been bringing our cars to Mr. Callahan (Earl to me and his many friends) for over ten years. It's just where we go.
